problem: The frozen bounded-occurrence binder commits the artifact-binding receipt with GITHUB_TOKEN. GitHub suppresses new workflow runs caused by most events emitted by GITHUB_TOKEN, so a downstream branch-only on:push workflow is not a reliable activation edge.
repair: Expose the already frozen downstream Study-C workflow through workflow_call and invoke it from the default-branch binder as a reusable workflow. The called workflow explicitly checks out relational-ttf-v01 so it reads the just-frozen binding receipt and current audit history.
